$comment: Design-token packages whose installed files declare a spacing scale. Used by scale: "auto" after the project's own stylesheets are checked. Each entry lists the files to read (relative to the package root) and, when the package does not use space/spacing names, the token pattern to match. Additions welcome; keep them to files that ship in the published package.

packages.name: @primer/primitives
packages.note: Primer names its spacing ladder size

packages.name: @carbon/layout
packages.note: $spacing-01..13 in rem, Sass variables; Carbon's styles package forwards them from here

packages.name: bootstrap
packages.note: $spacer and the $spacers map; Bootstrap-derived systems (AdminLTE, CoreUI, Tabler) inherit it from here

packages.name: @mittwald/flow-design-tokens
packages.note: one size scale in two units, --size-px--* and --size-rem--*, same steps

packages.name: @mozilla-protocol/tokens
packages.note: --spacing-xs..2xl in px; Protocol's Sass $spacing-* come from the same package

packages.name: @wordpress/base-styles
packages.note: WordPress names its spacing scale $grid-unit-05..80 (4 to 64px, multiples of $grid-unit)

packages.name: @wordpress/theme
packages.note: --wpds-dimension-gap-* and --wpds-dimension-padding-* in px; size and surface tokens are not spacing

packages.name: @wikimedia/codex-design-tokens
packages.note: Codex ladder --spacing-0..400 (0 to 64px); the named --spacing-* tokens are computed component values
